newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Sept 3.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Sept 3.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- King Fahd says Saudi Arabia spent 153 billion riyals on education in the fifth five-year plan.
- Saudi Arabia is the seventh country in the world in terms of encouraging foreign investment. It reached $22 billion in 1995.
- Cost-of-living in Saudi Arabia rises 0.6 percent in the first quarter of 1996.
- Fight against video piracy yields results in the kingdom.
- Officials step up efforts to recover loss of 18 million riyals remittances following the collapse of a money exchange.
